entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: A plane with two suns, Karu and Ezza, formed by the merging of two demi-planes; home to Strixhaven University.

entities.name: Ezroi
entities.description: One of two demi-planes that merged to form Arcavios.

entities.name: Karudis
entities.description: One of two demi-planes that merged to form Arcavios.

entities.name: Strixhaven University
entities.description: Arcavios's premier school of magic, founded by the five Founder Dragons at the epicenter of the snarls and divided into five colleges.

entities.name: Founder Dragons
entities.description: The five elder dragons born from the snarls who founded Strixhaven: Shadrix Silverquill, Galazeth Prismari, Beledros Witherbloom and Velomachus Lorehold.

entities.name: Shadrix Silverquill
entities.description: Founder Dragon of Silverquill who founded the Forum of Amity.

entities.name: Galazeth Prismari
entities.description: Founder Dragon of Prismari who had the idea of founding Strixhaven at the epicenter of the snarls.

entities.name: Beledros Witherbloom
entities.description: Founder Dragon of Witherbloom.

entities.name: Velomachus Lorehold
entities.description: Founder Dragon of Lorehold.

entities.name: Archaics
entities.description: Wise, eyeless, eight-armed giants who are the reincarnated souls of Strixhaven's oracles.

entities.name: Jadzi
entities.description: An oracle of Strixhaven whose mind Jace accessed as she died and traveled back in time.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who saw the plane's creation through Jadzi's mind.

entities.name: Snarls
entities.description: Sites where opposing mana overlapped at the plane's birth, where magic is most powerful and dangerous.

entities.name: Dawning Age
entities.description: The period when the plane was young and no humanoids lived on it.

entities.name: Blood Age
entities.description: Six millennia of tremendous violence after humanoids emerged, ended by the Founder Dragons.

entities.name: Golwanda the Bloodspiller
entities.description: A leader of orcish Thunder Riders who united the steppe peoples around 1539 AR.

entities.name: Xandril the Executioner
entities.description: A kor who rallied the Hordeland fiefdoms against Golwanda.

entities.name: Oriq
entities.description: A group of mages who sought to access Strixhaven's magical archives, defeated by Professors and Planeswalkers under Professor Vess.

entities.name: Professor Vess
entities.description: Professor who led the defeat of the Oriq and thwarted Kasmina's plot.

entities.name: Kasmina
entities.description: A professor whose plot to destroy the omenpaths and disintegrate Arcavios was thwarted.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian assault on many planes, which nearly toppled Strixhaven.

entities.name: Omenpaths
entities.description: Pathways opening the Multiverse to Arcavios.

entities.name: Arch Obscura
entities.description: A massive spherical star arch with an unpredictable orbit that can eclipse a sun.

entities.name: Star Arches
entities.description: Floating arch-shaped relics from the Dawning Age.

entities.name: Pathwardens
entities.description: An organization created to secure Omenpath manifestation points and check interplanar travelers.

entities.name: Arcavios Preservation Society
entities.description: An intercollegiate society of Strixhaven students who build devices to destabilize Omenpaths.

entities.name: Dragonsguard
entities.description: An elite force of Strixhaven graduate mages who work with the Founder Dragons.

entities.name: Biblioplex
entities.description: The largest library in the Multiverse, at the center of Strixhaven.

events.summary: More than 7000 years before 4564 AR, the demi-planes Ezroi and Karudis merge to form Arcavios, creating the snarls.
events.quote: two demi- planes , Ezroi and Karudis , merged bizarrely and uniquely

events.summary: The five elder dragons are born from the snarls.
events.quote: The five elder dragons of Arcavios were born from these snarls.

events.summary: Jace, through Jadzi's mind, sees the planes colliding amid Eldrazi horrors.
events.quote: formless Eldrazi horrors snaking around the great ships battling them

events.summary: The dragons learn to accept disciplined mortal study of magic as humanoids arise, ending the Dawning Age.
events.quote: The humanoids' emergence marked the end of the Dawning Age, replacing it with an age of conflict.

events.summary: Golwanda and Xandril clash around 1539 AR on blood-soaked battlefields.
events.quote: the forces of Golwanda the Bloodspiller and Xandril the Executioner clashed on blood-soaked battlefields

events.summary: The Founder Dragons end the Blood Age by creating an institution to train mages for peace.
events.quote: The Founder Dragons brought the Blood Age to an end, creating an institution to train mages for peace.

events.summary: Galazeth Prismari proposes that the five dragons found Strixhaven University at the epicenter of the snarls.
events.quote: Galazeth Prismari had the idea for the five elder Dragons to found Strixhaven University at the epicenter of the snarls

events.summary: The Oriq are defeated by a coalition of professors and planeswalkers led by Professor Vess.
events.quote: The Oriq were defeated by a coalition of Professors and Planeswalkers under the leadership of Professor Vess.

events.summary: The New Phyrexian Invasion nearly topples Strixhaven, with most deans compleated, until the Invocation of the Founders repels it.
events.quote: most of the deans compleated and red sinew growth spreading throughout the college

events.summary: Lorehold College leads the rebuilding of Strixhaven after the Invasion.
events.quote: Lorehold College led the rebuilding of the Strixhaven campus.

events.summary: Strixhaven welcomes its first exoplanar students in 4563 AR and charts nearby Omenpaths by 4564 AR.
events.quote: The inaugural class of exoplanar students was welcomed at Strixhaven in 4563 AR

events.summary: Professor Vess thwarts Professor Kasmina's plot to destroy the omenpaths and disintegrate Arcavios.
events.quote: Professor Vess thwarted a plot by Professor Kasmina

events.summary: Around 4565 AR the archaics become erratic and tensions reignite between Silkmeadow and Tor-Kathorr over All-Gleam.
events.quote: many of the normally gentle archaics became erratic and incensed, randomly attacking others on the plane

relations.quote: The five Elder Dragons that founded Strixhaven

relations.note: Led the coalition that defeated them.
relations.quote: The Oriq were defeated by a coalition of Professors and Planeswalkers under the leadership of Professor Vess.
Professor Vess thwarted a plot by Professor Kasmina
Strixhaven University is situated in northeast Orrithia.

relations.note: Archaics are the reincarnated souls of Strixhaven's oracles.
relations.quote: archaics are the reincarnated souls of the oracles of Strixhaven

relations.note: The Pathwardens secure Omenpaths the Society tries to destabilize.
relations.quote: They build explosive devices to destabilize Omenpaths.
